questions.independentDerivation: In triangle ABC, AB = 35 tan(41°) ≈ 30.4250 cm. In triangle ABD, sin θ = AB/93, so θ = arcsin(35 tan(41°)/93) ≈ 19.095939°. The fractional degree is approximately 5.75634 minutes, giving θ = 19°6′ to the nearest minute. The Short and Worked answers agree.
